entities.title: invoker
entities.summary: The small `zazzle` program in macos/c/zazzle that passes its command line, standard streams and working directory to the daemon and exits with the daemon's status, or execs zazzled or a standalone tool for the commands that run as their own process.
notToBeConfusedWith: `zazzled run`, which runs a zazzle command in its own process without a daemon

entities.title: zazzle run / zazzled run
entities.summary: Two different things: `zazzle run -- CMD` runs any program and prints its output cleaned with a profile (it execs `zazzled wrap`); `zazzled run CMD..` runs one zazzle command, such as `read` or `status`, in-process without a daemon or persistent cache.

entities.title: session
entities.summary: The key under which the daemon remembers what it has sent: ZAZZLE_SESSION on the command line, or one random `mcp-...` id per `zazzled mcp` process.
notToBeConfusedWith: A connection: the invoker opens one per command, all in the same session.

entities.title: response id
entities.summary: The `[r:ID]` that starts an answer sent in a session: at least five characters, derived from the session and the answer's text; `read-again r:ID` fetches it again.
notToBeConfusedWith: An output id: ten characters, given to clean, `zazzle run` and proxied outputs whether or not there is a session, and looked up in the output store.

entities.title: already-sent notice
entities.summary: `[r:ID] already sent: zazzle CMD ARGS, unchanged. If you no longer have it: read-again r:ID`, given instead of an answer the session was sent identically within its last 40,000 estimated tokens.

entities.title: sha
entities.summary: The first 8 hex digits of a file's BLAKE3 hash, shown in read's header (with --source for C# files) and edit's answer; edit --expect accepts any prefix of at least four of them.
notToBeConfusedWith: A git object id or a SHA-1/SHA-2 digest.

entities.title: anchor
entities.summary: Three base-32 characters hashed from one line's text, shown as `N#xyz` by read --anchors; edit --at A#xyz-B#xyz is refused if either line's anchor changed.

entities.title: terse view
entities.summary: A shortened rendering of a file that read shows instead of the code: zazzle-csharp-indexer's behaviour-preserving view of a C# file, or zazzled's own view of an HTML or Razor file (markup.rs), a CSS, SCSS, Sass or Less file (styles.rs), a Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, Rust, Go, Java, Kotlin, Swift, C, C++, Ruby, PHP, Scala, Perl, Lua, Elixir, Haskell, OCaml, F#, Clojure, Erlang, R, Julia, Zig, Objective-C, Groovy, PowerShell, Visual Basic or shell file (terse.rs), a Nim or SQL file (nim.rs, sql.rs), a JSON, YAML, TOML or Markdown file (data.rs, md.rs), or an XML file, INI file or Dockerfile (xml.rs, config.rs). `N` unchanged lines, `N~` changed lines and `A-B ⋯ note` hidden ranges, with source line numbers and no sha.
notToBeConfusedWith: An outline, which lists symbols and their ranges, not code.

entities.title: profile
entities.summary: In `zazzle run`, a named set of rules for one tool (cargo, pytest, go, dotnet, js-test, tsc, install) that drops and counts lines known to be noise and groups diagnostics; detected from the command or named with --profile.

entities.title: budget
entities.summary: A cap on an answer's size in estimated tokens (bytes × 2 / 7, rounded up): 8000 by default, 3000 per file for read and for read-again --full; clean, `zazzle run` and the proxy have their own, 8000 by default.

entities.title: racy
entities.summary: Said of a cached record or listing taken within 2 seconds of the modification time it depends on; it is not trusted, because a later write in the same instant would not change the timestamp.

entities.title: relay mode
entities.summary: A request without passed descriptors: the daemon sends the status byte and the text back on the socket. Used by the MCP front end; the invoker uses descriptor mode, where the daemon writes to the caller's own streams.

entities.title: output id
entities.summary: The ten-character `[r:ID]` of a stored clean, `zazzle run` or proxied output, derived from the text shown and its input; `read-again r:ID` returns the output as shown and `--full` its input, for an hour.
notToBeConfusedWith: A response id, which a session gives a find, read, ls, outline or refs answer and which read-again reruns.

entities.title: language module
entities.summary: A tree-sitter grammar built as a shared library (macos/rust/zazzle-lang) and published beside the zazzle download; zazzled downloads it on demand, accepts it only with the SHA-256 in its compiled-in manifest, and loads it with dlopen.
notToBeConfusedWith: zazz scripts, which are WebAssembly programs a user adds, not grammars
